title: 3-Day Highlights of Southern Laos
headline: Bolaven, Vat Phou and the 4000 Islands — the short complete circuit
price_note: From $XX per person — Standard accommodation. Comfort upgrades available.
dream: Three days for travellers with little time who still want the three pillars of the south: the Bolaven Plateau with Phu Krateh, Vat Phou and Champasak, then a night on Don Khone with Li Phi and Khone Phapheng. Faster than the 3-Day Classic, with a volcano viewpoint instead of a full Bolaven market day.
highlights: Tad Fane, Tad Yuang and Jhai Coffee
Li Phi, French remains and Khone Phapheng

itinerary.title: Bolaven Plateau and Phu Krateh
itinerary.body: Tad Fane, Tad Yuang, Jhai Coffee, Phu Krateh summit (~1,300 m), overnight Pakse. Meals: Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Vat Phou, Tomo and the 4,000 Islands
itinerary.body: Vat Phou, Champasak, Tomo temple, boat to Don Khone overnight. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner.

itinerary.title: Islands, Khone Phapheng, Pakse or border
itinerary.body: Li Phi, Khonepasoi, Khone Phapheng, then Pakse or Nong Nok Khiene border. Meals: Breakfast / Lunch. Total distance: about 505 km.

included: Private minivan and driver + local island transport
Meals as mentioned + entrance fees + bottled water
